assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, building height, density, green ratio and setback values remain unknown in metrics.json; no pseudo-precise controls are invented.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional constraints derived from announcement text and approximate area values.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, layers, figures, PDFs and HTML must be fully recalculated when cleared official polygons are released; provisional values must not be used as official redline, approval basis or precise-area basis.

assumptions.statement: The 24 building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson are conceptual design proposals distributed across three key areas; they do not correspond to surveyed existing buildings.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish decisions require professional survey, ownership negotiation, structural appraisal and carbon/public-interest comparison before any demolition can be discussed.

assumptions.statement: Zhongzhiyuan controlled-testing scenarios (T-01) must not enter real public environments until equipment safety, noise (55dB night limit), energy and test-spillover risks are professionally assessed and permitted.
assumptions.impact: Safety officer presence, manual result confirmation and emergency stop are required throughout; public summaries are released only after human review.

assumptions.statement: Haidian and Beijing administrative-scale statistical sources are background calibration only, flagged not_spatially_allocable=true in sources.json.
assumptions.impact: These figures never enter metrics.json, GeoJSON, areas, alignments or phasing; they only calibrate problem priorities and cannot substitute corridor-level baseline surveys.

assumptions.statement: The seven global cases (CASE-STATION-F through CASE-SEAPORT) provide transferable mechanism comparisons only.
assumptions.impact: Cases do not support local performance analogy, spatial controls, regulatory conclusions or implementation guarantees for the Jing-Zhang corridor.

assumptions.statement: Annual activity calendar, developer council, scenario-opening mechanism, contribution points and international communication framework are conceptual suggestions.
assumptions.impact: They do not constitute government decisions, investment commitments or implementation arrangements; all require competent subjects and formal approval paths before execution.

assumptions.statement: PDFs and figures now use Noto Sans SC (SIL Open Font License v1.1), which permits commercial use, modification and redistribution. SimHei has been replaced. No pending font license blocker remains.
assumptions.impact: Font licensing is resolved; A3/A0 PDFs and all figures use OFL-licensed Noto Sans SC.

assumptions.statement: Cost ranges and durations in the action package table are conceptual order-of-magnitude references for discussion, not investment estimates or construction schedules. Formal initiation requires professional cost preparation, approval procedures and funding plans.
assumptions.impact: Action packages remain implementable concepts; no financial or schedule commitment is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Corridor ridership, station OD flows, bicycle parking occupancy, accessibility continuity, complaint baselines and aggregated courier/ride-hailing data are not yet available from cleared or official sources.
assumptions.impact: Transport indicators stay unknown in metrics.json; administrative-scale citywide averages are never used to fill corridor-level baselines or pilot performance targets.

assumptions.statement: Agent independently queried OpenStreetMap via Overpass API on 2026-08-10 to verify PROV-SITE-001 boundary against real-world features. Found 7 metro stations inside, 0 registered parks inside, Dazhongsi station outside boundary (~200m).
assumptions.impact: Verification confirms corridor has real transit connectivity basis; green space design is new creation not appropriation; Dazhongsi walking corridor design is validated by station being outside boundary. OSM data is ODbL licensed and publicly auditable.
